scope: Cancellation during fixed-grid Coons and tensor-product patch construction
implementation: Both patch types expose transactional to_triangles_with_cancel. Check before construction, at every vertex evaluation, before every cell emits triangles, and before returning. Cancellation truncates output to its original length. The streamed production encoder propagates the generation error explicitly and stops further patch processing.
verified: Both patch types independently cancel at every observed checkpoint, with more than 700 checkpoints per type.
Every cancellation preserves the caller's preexisting output prefix and removes all triangles generated by the interrupted call.
Successful construction preserves point bits and all nine color components relative to the existing no-cancellation entrypoint.
Real PDF/AI RAM, swap and Metal tests continue to pass.
limitations: No measured wall-clock cancellation latency or full viewer navigation race qualification.
Other parsing, visibility inventory, color-function evaluation and final renderer work remain incompletely interruptible.
The full format, cache, HDR and NVIDIA/CUDA objective remains incomplete.
